notes: Letter on the chemical reactivity of graphene on vdW substrates (UV/ozone etching, HSQ e-beam hydrogenation, O2 plasma, Raman/optical imaging, LDA calculations of H-atom chemisorption). Hydrogen storage is mentioned only as an application (Abstract; main p. 5, 'Our findings have strong implications in design strategies of graphene/graphite electrodes for hydrogen storage'; SI Section 7 'Possible device implementation'). The 340 C anneal in Ar/H2 (9/1) is a cleaning step with no uptake measured. No surface area is reported. Not coded theoretical_only because the paper contains experimental work, not only computation; not coded electrochemical because the hydrogen is not charged in an electrolyte. not_primary, retracted (record is_retracted false; no retraction notice in the PDF text) and duplicate_data do not apply. Per the instruction, I1 failure with no H2 uptake value is coded no_conditions_stated.
